messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-commit activation plan & canary schedule — Trillium Health

Hi Alexandra —

Congrats again on the signature. Attached is our initial mutual action plan (MAP) that embeds a post-commit activation playbook: rollout phases, canary window, migration checkpoints, and training cadence. High-level ask: please review and confirm the availability for the proposed canary week (Jan 10–14) and the two-week training window preceding it.

Quick summary:
- Phase 0 (prep, Dec 16–Jan 7): infra provisioning, KMS setup, and readiness checklist
- Phase 1 (pilot/canary, Jan 10–14): 5% traffic, smoke tests, rollback gating criteria
- Phase 2 (staged ramp, Jan 17–Feb 4): incremental capacity increases + observability tuning
- Phase 3 (cutover/migration, Feb 7–Feb 11): final data sync + handoff
- Training: two live sessions (recorded) + train-the-trainer two weeks prior to pilot

Acceptance criteria (examples):
- < 150ms median gen latency at 95th percentile during canary load tests
- No functional/regression failures on 100 curated eval prompts
- KV cache hit-rate > 60% for common prefixes (measured during pilot)

Attachments: Trillium-MAP-v1.xlsx, canary-checklist-20261215.pdf, training-roster-template.csv

Next steps:
1) Alex: confirm canary dates and training attendee list by Thu 12/17
2) We: finalize runbooks and provide pre-canary run rehearsal
3) Procurement: finalize SOW and payment milestone (we'll loop procurement where needed)

If useful, we can walk through the MAP in a 30-min working session tomorrow.

Thanks,
Ben

Thanks — this looks thorough and exactly the level of detail we need. A few clarifying questions before I confirm dates: 

1) For Phase 1 (canary) you list 5% traffic — do you have an objective metric for error budget (e.g., error rate threshold or acceptable 4xx/5xx %) we should watch?
2) Training: we'd like one additional role added (Data Ops) for the train-the-trainer session. I'll attach an internal roster separately.
3) Cutover: can you confirm whether the data migration requires a maintenance window that would affect client traffic on Feb 7? Our ops team needs lead time to notify stakeholders.

If those answers are straightforward I can confirm the Jan 10–14 pilot window; otherwise propose pushing to Jan 24–28.

Appreciate the quick turn — I will get the procurement contacts looped for SOW once dates are set.

Hi Alexandra — thanks for the quick review and great questions. Answers below and I've attached an updated MAP (minor edits + explicit gating thresholds).

1) Error budget / observable thresholds for Phase 1 (pilot/canary):
   - 5xx rate: alarm if > 0.8% sustained over 5 minutes
   - 4xx rate (client errors): alarm if > 2% sustained over 10 minutes
   - Latency: 95th percentile can't exceed 250ms during load ramps (we'll use step ramps in rehearsal)
   - Functional check: 100-run eval harness — zero critical regressions; any failure blocks ramp

2) Training roster: we'll add Data Ops to the train-the-trainer. Please send the names/emails for the 6 people who should be on the roster by EOD Thu 12/17. We'll handle calendar invites and provide pre-read.

3) Migration window impact: the final sync (Phase 3) will require a short maintenance window (planned 2 hours) during off-peak (we propose 02:00–04:00 local time on Feb 8). The intent is zero-downtime for reads; we will divert write traffic and queue deltas for replay. We'll publish detailed fallbacks in the runbook. If the Feb 8 window conflicts, we can reschedule to Feb 9 overnight.

Proposed confirmed timeline (pending your confirmation):
- Training week (live sessions + TtT): Jan 3–7 (week before rehearsal)
- Rehearsal run & dry-run: Jan 7 (full dress rehearsal with smoke tests)
- Canary: Jan 10–14 (5% traffic; gating thresholds above)
- Staged ramp: Jan 17–Feb 4
- Cutover & final migration: Feb 7–8 (maintenance window Feb 8 02:00–04:00)

I've also included the HubSpot deal and the DocuSign link in the MAP top sheet for your procurement team.

Next items for Alex: confirm attendee list + final canary date (we can keep Jan 10–14 or move to Jan 24–28 if needed). Once you confirm, Ben/Monica and I will finalize the runbooks and send a calendar invite for the Jan 7 rehearsal.

Thanks,
